purpose.en: Migrate the verified SmartMeeting SmartPay5 fix so 30% burn-on-transfer GLC can fund SmartLingo course subscriptions without exact-recipient-balance reverts.
purpose.zh: 迁移已在 SmartMeeting 验证的 SmartPay5 修复，使转账自动燃烧 30% 的 GLC 可用于 SmartLingo 课程订阅，不再因收款余额必须精确增加而回滚。

en: SmartPay5 permits fee-on-transfer tokens while retaining on-chain product and payment-ratio rules.
Claims trust the verified SmartPay5 transaction record for payerID, administrator refID, course mainID, learning-language secondID, token identity, and transaction time.
Receipt transfer amounts are not revalidated; course access dates start from the on-chain transaction timestamp.
zh: SmartPay5 支持转账收费/燃烧代币，同时保留链上产品与付款比例规则。
认领以已验证 SmartPay5 交易记录中的 payerID、管理员 refID、课程 mainID、学习语言 secondID、代币身份与交易时间为准。
不再二次核验回执转账金额；课程权限日期以链上交易时间为起点。

en: SmartLingo's three supported three-month course products, twelve learning-language secondIDs, Polygon SmartPay administration, checkout, reconciliation, and account lookup.
Header, Footer, branding, course prices, card payments, classrooms, learning data, and historical SmartPay3/SmartPay4 claims remain unchanged.
zh: 涉及 SmartLingo 三个三个月课程产品、十二种学习语言 secondID、Polygon SmartPay 管理、结账、核对与账户查询。
Header、Footer、品牌、课程价格、银行卡付款、教室、学习数据及既有 SmartPay3/SmartPay4 认领均保持不变。

en: Replace SmartPay4 runtime source, ABI, deployment controls, settings, and current claim table name with SmartPay5.
Remove recipient balance-delta and backend amount verification while retaining verified contract identity, transaction event, confirmations, payer/product/token matching, and site isolation.
Add migration 0179, preserve prior claims and purchase history, allow SmartPay5 as a purchase provider, and add a five-wallet 30% burn-token regression.
zh: 以 SmartPay5 替换 SmartPay4 的运行时源码、ABI、部署控制、设置及当前认领表名。
移除收款余额增量与后端金额核验，同时保留合约身份、交易事件、确认数、付款人/产品/代币匹配及站点隔离验证。
新增 0179 迁移，保留既有认领与购买历史，允许 SmartPay5 作为购买提供方，并新增五钱包 30% 燃烧代币回归测试。

en: SmartPay5 must compile reproducibly and prove a nominal 10M burn-token course payment succeeds while all five payout wallets receive 70% of each nominal split.
All 74 migrations must replay exactly once with zero foreign-key violations; the full Linux build, automated suite, deployment, and production availability checks must pass.
zh: SmartPay5 必须可重现编译，并证明名义 1000 万燃烧代币课程付款成功、五个收款钱包各收到名义分配的 70%。
全部 74 个迁移必须仅应用一次且无外键违规；完整 Linux 构建、自动测试、部署与线上可用性检查必须通过。

en: A new site-owned SmartPay5 contract must be deployed and configured before live token payments resume; the user will perform the authenticated wallet payment test.
zh: 必须先部署并配置新的站点专属 SmartPay5 合约，真实代币付款才会恢复；用户将执行登录态钱包付款测试。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's three three-month rules, selected learning language as secondID, permanent administrator as product-owner refID, twelve supported language codes, site-local D1, and existing course prices.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 三个三个月规则、所选学习语言 secondID、永久管理员产品 Owner refID、十二种语言代码、站点独立 D1 与既有课程价格。

rollback.en: Restore the pre-release D1 snapshot and previous Worker together; historical SmartPay3 and SmartPay4 claims and purchases are retained in the migrated data.
rollback.zh: 同时恢复发布前的 D1 快照与上一版 Worker；迁移数据中保留既有 SmartPay3 与 SmartPay4 认领及购买记录。
